## Description
&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Aluminum is extracted from aluminum oxide (alumina) primarily through the Hall–Héroult &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;process, an industrial electrolytic method invented in 1886 by Charles Martin Hall &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;and Paul Héroult.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;The chemical reactions involved are:&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#9;Al2O3 + 3C → 2Al + 3CO2&#10;&#9;&#9;
